summary: Verified all 6 bug fixes reported by main agent for /app/bidar (Telethon Python userbot). Full test suite: 129/129 pre-existing tests pass. Added 22 targeted verification tests in /app/bidar/tests/test_bug_fixes_verification.py covering every reported fix + regression spot-checks; all 22 pass. Combined total: 151/151 pytest tests pass. Also verified via grep/inspect that: `urlretrieve` and `_sc_download_and_send` are absent from bidar.py; `RotatingFileHandler` + `import logging.handlers` are present; VERSION='1.11.3'; README badge is 1.11.3; .env.example no longer references .update/renderer.py/BIDAR_UPDATE_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: bidar.py is 3786 lines — no refactor requested this iteration, but the file is well above the 700-line healthy threshold. Suggest a follow-up split into modules (music/, tldr/, i18n/, config, handlers/) in a future iteration.
_whitelist_contains(cid, lst) parameter order (cid first, lst second) is opposite of the intuitive '(container, item)' convention — worth noting in a docstring to prevent future misuse; not a bug.

The RotatingFileHandler is attached to the root logger via logging.basicConfig; bidar's own logger 'bidar' inherits it, which is correct. Pytest's default log capture wraps handlers so runtime introspection during tests appears empty — source-level verification is authoritative.
test_credentials: None required; test suite stubs API_ID/API_HASH/PHONE env vars and mocks telethon/yt_dlp/emergentintegrations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Project is a standalone Telethon userbot (/app/bidar/bidar.py, ~3786 lines). NO supervisor services, NO REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, NO curl. Test with: cd /app/bidar && python -m pytest tests/ -v. Telethon 1.43.2 is actually installed in the venv, so tests just insert /app/bidar into sys.path and `import bidar` — do NOT MagicMock telethon.tl.functions.* (it will break the import). Env vars API_ID/API_HASH/PHONE must be stubbed BEFORE `import bidar` (bidar reads them at module load). Fixes verified: (1) _parse_github_repo handles repos ending in t/i/g/./chat and only strips trailing '.git'; (2) whitelist helpers _is_chat_allowed/_whitelist_contains/_whitelist_without gracefully skip garbage entries ('oops', None, '12.5') without ValueError — note the API is _whitelist_contains(cid, lst) with cid FIRST; (3) _BOT_MSG_PREFIXES tuple includes all 12 new emoji prefixes (🔍🔒🎨🖼👴🧒📰🌐📦▶️📊📖); (4) no `urlretrieve` anywhere in bidar.py; (5) RotatingFileHandler + `import logging.handlers` present at lines 27 & 164; (6) _sc_download_and_send removed and VERSION='1.11.3' in bidar.py and README.md badge. All 151 tests green.
